017package org.apache.juneau.http.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
022
023/**
024 * Represents an <c>HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect</c> response.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * The request and all future requests should be repeated using another URI.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
031 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
032 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
033 * (and possibly earlier).
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
036 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041public class PermanentRedirect extends BasicHttpResponse<PermanentRedirect> {
042
043   /** HTTP status code */
044   public static final int STATUS_CODE = 308;
045
046   /** Reason phrase */
047   public static final String REASON_PHRASE = "Permanent Redirect";
048
049   /** Default status line */
050   private static final HttpStatusLine STATUS_LINE = HttpStatusLineBean.of(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE);
051
052   /** Default unmodifiable instance */
053   public static final PermanentRedirect INSTANCE = new PermanentRedirect().unmodifiable();
054
055   /**
056    * Constructor.
057    */
058   public PermanentRedirect() {
059      super(STATUS_LINE);
060   }
061
062   /**
063    * Constructor with a response body.
064    *
065    * @param body The response body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
066    */
067   public PermanentRedirect(HttpBody body) {
068      super(STATUS_LINE, body);
069   }
070
071   /**
072    * Constructor with a plain-text string body.
073    *
074    * @param body The response body as a plain-text string. May be <jk>null</jk>.
075    */
076   public PermanentRedirect(String body) {
077      super(STATUS_LINE, body);
078   }
079
080   /**
081    * Copy constructor.
082    *
083    * @param copyFrom The bean to copy from. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
084    */
085   public PermanentRedirect(PermanentRedirect copyFrom) {
086      super(copyFrom);
087   }
088
089   @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
090   public PermanentRedirect unmodifiable() {
091      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link PermanentRedirect} response.
096    *
097    * <p>
098    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
099    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
100    */
101   public static class Unmodifiable extends PermanentRedirect implements UnmodifiableBean {
102
103      /**
104       * Constructor.
105       *
106       * @param copyFrom The response to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
107       */
108      @SuppressWarnings({
109         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
110      })
111      protected Unmodifiable(PermanentRedirect copyFrom) {
112         super(copyFrom);
113         freeze();
114      }
115
116      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
117      protected PermanentRedirect modify(Runnable mutation) {
118         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
119      }
120   }
121}
